pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable liù? (1 mark)
   A. No letter
   B. l
   C. u
   D. i

2. What does 午饭 (wǔfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To eat
   B. Lunch
   C. Grapes
   D. Beef

3. What does 冰箱 (bīngxiāng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fridge
   B. Left side
   C. Sofa
   D. Beside

4. Which Chinese word means "to sing"? (1 mark)
   A. 唱歌 chànggē
   B. 盘子 pánzi
   C. 礼物 lǐwù
   D. 快乐 kuàilè

5. Which punctuation mark do we use between items in a list? (1 mark)
   A. !
   B. ?
   C. 、
   D. 。

6. What does 吗 ma do at the end of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It makes a yes-or-no question
   B. It ends a list
   C. It means and
   D. It means mother

7. Which body word is a single character, one you can write with 3 strokes? (1 mark)
   A. 耳 ěr (ear)
   B. 目 mù (eye)
   C. 头 tóu (head)
   D. 口 kǒu (mouth)

8. What does 玩 (wán) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. To play
   C. Plate
   D. Candle

9. What does 说 (shuō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wash hands
   B. To speak
   C. To listen, to hear
   D. Knee

10. In the syllable hǎo, which part is the final? (1 mark)
   A. o only
   B. ao
   C. hǎ
   D. h

11. What does 教堂 jiàotáng mean? (1 mark)
   A. House
   B. Church
   C. School
   D. Mosque

12. Read the pinyin: xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday I rest at home.
   B. On Sunday, go to church.
   C. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   D. On Wednesday I go to school.

13. Which sentence means "The television is in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在客厅。
   B. 花园在房子右边。
   C. 窗户在沙发上面。
   D. 电视在桌子上。

14. Which sentence means "The sofa is beside the door."? (1 mark)
   A. 床在卧室。
   B. 沙发在门旁边。
   C. 浴室在花园旁边。
   D. 电视在客厅。

15. Which word is pronounced bízi? (1 mark)
   A. 肩膀
   B. 鼻子
   C. 用
   D. 牙

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." (2 marks)

17. Break the syllables hǎo, jiào and nǐ into initial and final. (3 marks)

18. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Sunday, go to church." (3 marks)

19. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水果 and 蔬菜. (2 marks)

20. Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday. (3 marks)

21. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 浴室. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — u
   With iu the mark goes on the second vowel, u.

2. B — Lunch
   午饭 (wǔfàn) means lunch.

3. A — Fridge
   冰箱 (bīngxiāng) means fridge.

4. A — 唱歌 chànggē
   唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

5. C — 、
   、 is the list comma.

6. A — It makes a yes-or-no question
   电视在桌子上吗? asks whether the television is on the table.

7. D — 口 kǒu (mouth)
   口 has three strokes; 头 has 5, 耳 has 6 and 目 has 5.

8. B — To play
   玩 (wán) means to play.

9. B — To speak
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

10. B — ao
   h is the initial and ao is the final. The tone mark sits on the a.

11. B — Church
   教堂 is a church.

12. B — On Sunday, go to church.
   xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. is 星期天,去教堂。, which means "On Sunday, go to church.".

13. A — 电视在客厅。
   电视在客厅。 (diànshì zài kètīng.) means "The television is in the living room.".

14. B — 沙发在门旁边。
   沙发在门旁边。 (shāfā zài mén pángbiān.) means "The sofa is beside the door.".

15. B — 鼻子
   鼻子 is pronounced bízi and means nose.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: hǎo = h + ao; jiào = j + iao; nǐ = n + i.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct syllable.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期天,去教堂。 xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: 水果: shuǐguǒ, fruit (as a group). 蔬菜: shūcài, vegetables.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 浴室: yùshì, bathroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
